title: Spindle config
description: How to build a Twine game with Spindle. Story metadata (title, IFID, story format) belongs in your StoryTitle and StoryData passages.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor validation.

src.description: Files or directories of Twee source, passed to Tweego. Tweego also bundles .js and .css files found here.

head.description: Globs of .html and .js files to insert into the page <head>. .js files are wrapped in <script> tags; other file types are ignored.

out.description: Path of the compiled HTML file. Defaults to output/<package name>.html, or output/index.html without a package name. Overridden by --out.
